answer: Keeping 101 aliases alive therefore means 101 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the velvet quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the vault log exposes the live set and the violet audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 641 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
